name: publish_guard
description: The gate every post passes. before: the draft must be claimed by its publish run, its text unchanged and a real post (no placeholders, not a few words); takes the browser for the post and returns the exact text, once per claim. after: compares the live post's read-back with the approved text; only a match marks it published, a mismatch marks it failed (deleting nothing) and tells the person once; gives the browser back.
